content_plan.target_title: Cover-Up Tattoo Manchester | Transform Old Ink | Vladimir Vishar
content_plan.page_job: The one page job the AI-answer evidence actually supports: a dedicated cover-up service page that states assessment terms, what can and cannot be covered, session logic and the consultation route.
content_plan.evidence_note: All four assigned titles are dedicated cover-up service pages from studios cited in the Google AI answer for 'tattoo cover up Manchester'. Two are Manchester-area (Last Supper), two are London (London Blue Lady) and are kept as page-job analogues, not as local competitors.
content_plan.cannibalization_guard: No new page is created. The existing /cover-up-tattoo-manchester/ page absorbs this work. Do not split cover-up content into a second page and do not duplicate the cover-up FAQ block that already exists on /faq/; link to it instead.

content_plan.exclusion_reason: Search and platform infrastructure rather than competitor content: a Google privacy policy, the Google homepage, a Reddit bot-verification interstitial and the bare Instagram root. None carries a page job.
